R(3,3): The least positive integer n such that every red-blue coloring of the edges of the complete graph on n vertices contains a monochromatic triangle.
v: The vertex fixed in the six-vertex argument.
a: One of three selected neighbors of v joined to v in the common color X.
b: One of three selected neighbors of v joined to v in the common color X.
c: One of three selected neighbors of v joined to v in the common color X.
X: The common color of the edges va, vb, and vc.
n: A positive integer denoting the number of vertices in the definition of R(3,3).
